name: Septemplex Tome (Minor Artifact)
body:
Aura strong varies; CL 16th

Slot none; Weight 5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This tome holds an infinite number of pages to inscribe spells upon. Any wizard who prepares spells from a Septemplex Tome can prepare bonus spells as if her Intelligence were 6 points higher. This is not an actual bonus to Intelligence and grants the user no additional benefit. A Septemplex Tome contains all sorcerer/wizard spells (save for those of the wielder’s prohibited schools, if they have them). At the GM’s discretion, it could certainly hold more spells.

DESTRUCTION

A special 9th-level spell must be designed that exists only to destroy the specific and particular Septemplex Tome into which it is inscribed. This spell, which has numerous expensive and rare material components, must then be cast on the Septemplex Tome by its owner.
